# Refund eligibility
Paid invoices qualify for a full refund within 30 days. Refunds above $100 require review. Unpaid invoices cannot be refunded.

# Subscription cancellation
Cancel a subscription to stop future billing. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the current subscription period. Cancellation does not automatically refund an invoice.

# Login recovery
Reset your password using the verified email recovery link if you cannot login. Never share passwords or recovery codes with support.

# Service outages
Check the service status page during an outage. Support will report restoration updates. Service credits require an incident review.

# Plan upgrades
Upgrade a subscription from Starter to Growth from the account settings page. The new plan price applies to future invoices.

# Invoice copies
Download invoice receipts from billing history. An invoice copy shows the payment date, currency and amount. Invoice copies do not change payment state.

# Data export
Export customer data in CSV format from the data settings page. Exports are available to account owners and expire after seven days.

# Data deletion
Delete personal data through a verified privacy request. Data deletion is irreversible and requires identity verification. Billing records may be retained.
